full_prompt_en: A square color fashion photograph frames a young woman's face so closely that her dark hair and the edges of her cheeks reach the picture borders. The background is almost entirely obscured, apart from a small cool blue area along the lower right. She faces mostly forward, with her head turned only slightly, looking toward the camera through gray-blue eyes. The eye on the right side of the image catches a bright point of light, while the other sits in softer shade. Full, softly parted lips hold a muted rose tone beneath a straight nose. Loose deep-brown hair falls around the face, catching copper highlights on the right and sinking into cool darkness on the left. Across her forehead, nose, cheek, and chin lies a fine irregular lattice of shadow, as if sunlight has passed through a woven screen. The tiny diamonds and crossing lines change scale with the contours of the skin; their brown-gray pattern becomes especially clear across the cheek nearest the light. Broad out-of-focus dark shapes veil parts of the upper left and lower foreground, giving the image an intimate layered depth. Warm directional sunlight comes from the right front, making the skin glow amber and bringing out freckles and fine texture, while the opposite side retains cool blue-gray shadow. The focus holds the eyes, lips, and central illuminated skin sharply enough to feel tactile, then lets surrounding hair and foreground interruptions soften. No clothing detail, setting, or readable text is prominent. The overall composition is close and atmospheric, balancing warm patterned light against cool softness and letting the gaze remain the still center.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形彩色时尚照片把一名年轻女子的脸框得极近，深色头发和脸颊边缘都触及画幅边界。背景几乎完全被遮住，仅右下沿留下小片冷蓝色。她大致正面朝向观者，头部只略微转动，灰蓝色眼睛望向镜头。画面右侧的眼睛接住一小点明亮光线，另一只则处在较柔和的阴影里。丰满而轻轻分开的嘴唇带低饱和玫瑰色，位于直鼻之下。松散的深棕色头发围着脸，在右侧接住铜色高光，左侧沉入冷暗。额头、鼻子、脸颊与下巴上落着细密而不规则的格网阴影，仿佛阳光穿过编织屏障。小小的菱形与交叉线条随皮肤曲面改变尺度，在受光较多的脸颊上尤其明显。失焦的宽阔暗形遮住左上和下方前景的一部分，赋予画面亲密的分层纵深。暖色定向阳光从右前方来，使皮肤发出琥珀色光泽，显出雀斑与细微纹理，另一侧则留着冷蓝灰阴影。焦点让眼睛、嘴唇和中央受光皮肤足够清楚，几乎可以触碰，而周围头发与前景遮挡逐渐柔化。服饰细节、具体场所和可读文字都不突出。整体构图紧凑而富有氛围，以暖色纹样光影平衡冷调柔焦，让目光成为静止的中心。
style_prompt_en: The color photograph relies on very close framing, shallow focus, and a patterned shaft of warm directional light. Amber and copper highlights meet cool blue-gray shadows, with subtle midtones carrying fine natural grain rather than polished smoothness. A delicate lattice of dark lines bends over rounded volume, making the light pattern a structural element of the image. Broad soft occlusions at the edges add depth and privacy, while the center holds selective crisp detail. Tonal transitions are gradual except where the projected pattern crosses a highlight, creating an alternating rhythm of sharp and diffuse edges. The background is reduced to quiet cool color, so intimate texture and the interplay of light and shadow dominate. The overall effect is sensual and contemplative, with optical layering making a simple surface feel complex.
style_prompt_zh: 这种彩色摄影依靠极近取景、浅景深和带纹样的暖色定向光。琥珀与铜色高光遇上冷蓝灰阴影，介于其间的中间调保留细微自然颗粒，而非磨成光滑表面。一道细密的深线网格沿圆润体积弯曲，让光影纹样成为画面的结构元素。边缘宽阔而柔和的遮挡增加纵深与私密感，中央则保留有选择的清晰细节。明度过渡通常渐进，只有投射纹样跨越高光时更陡峭，形成清晰边缘与弥散边缘交替的节奏。背景被缩减为安静的冷色，使亲密肌理和光影交互占据主导。整体效果感性而沉思，光学层叠让简单表面显得复杂。
theme_en: A close sunlit face crossed by delicate netlike shadows
theme_zh: 细密网状影子掠过受阳光照亮的近景面容
name: David Bellemere
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
